effectSummary.ko: 10m 안의 적 하나에게 0.15초 간격으로 D45% 화살 3발을 쏩니다. 한 번의 시전이며 기본 공격으로 세지 않습니다. 각 화살은 벽에 막힙니다.
effectSummary.en: Fire 3 D45% physical arrows at one target within 10m, 0.15s apart. This is one cast, not three basic attacks. Each arrow collides with walls.

productionConcept: Three broad-headed arrows follow one another closely along the same diagonal firing lane, offset in distance like successive shots, with three compact ivory release accents. They remain parallel in a narrow train, clearly different from a spreading fan.
